title: Affine scalar endomorphism action on sections over its chart
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an affine open, and $A=\Gamma(X,U)$. Write $\Phi$ for affinePerfectSheafification [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model], and $P$ for ordinary direct image from the slice over $U$ [def-sc-affine-free-basis-germs]. Let $\mu_a:A\to A$ be multiplication by $a\in A$ [def-sc-affine-free-basis-germs]. For every section $m\in\Gamma(U,P\Phi(A))$, the component of $P\Phi(\mu_a)$ over $U$ sends $m$ to $a m$. No point or stalk is part of this assertion.

proof.text: On every basic open of Spec A, localization of the linear map r maps to ar acts as multiplication by the structure-sheaf image of a, by the localization relations. The tilde construction glues these maps; equality of section maps on a basis gives equality on every open by separatedness.

Unfold the restriction along hU.isoSpec.hom and the inverse over equivalence. At the top of U, isoSpec_hom_appTop is GammaSpecIso.hom followed by U.topIso.inv, hence sends the canonical section of a to the top section corresponding to a. At the slice object U times U the scalar is its restriction along the second projection. The ring map defining pushforwardOver is exactly this restriction, so the scalar action on the pushed-forward module over U is a times m. This is a calculation with the structure-ring comparison maps, and does not use a stalk or the explicit unit germ.

theorem affineScalarEnd_section_action (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    let P := SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u}
      (SheafOfModules.pushforwardOver (R := moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U)
    ∀ m : (P.obj ((affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).obj
        (ModuleCat.of Γ(X, U) Γ(X, U)))).val.obj (.op U),
      (P.map ((affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).map
        (affineScalarEnd X U a))).val.app (.op U) m = a • m
